title: DA: El Niño affects 12,595 farmers in Ilocos Region, causes P346M losses

blocks.text: SAN ILDEFONSO, Ilocos Sur — The impact of El Niño has affected 12,595 farmers and damaged about 5,694 hectares of agricultural land in the Ilocos Region, causing an estimated P346.12 million in agricultural losses, according to the Department of Agriculture (DA). The DA Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Operations Center (DA-DRRM OpCen) reported these figures in its latest monitoring update on the weather phenomenon’s effects in the region on Friday, Nov. 20.
